recommendations.decision: Increase controlled acquisition tests in Affiliate
recommendations.evidence: Matured customers acquired through Affiliate generated EUR 67.06 per acquired customer in 90 days, 123.4% above the all-channel average.
recommendations.action: Reallocate 10% of marginal prospecting budget for a four-week incrementality test; guard on CAC payback and volume quality.

recommendations.evidence: Social has the weakest checkout-to-order rate at 70.0%. A 2 percentage-point lift is worth about 26 orders / EUR 3,655 at current AOV.
recommendations.action: Test guest checkout, payment-message clarity, and mobile form simplification; measure incremental completed orders.
recommendations.expected_impact: Approximately EUR 3,655 revenue per observed period

recommendations.decision: Launch a value-based win-back program for at-risk customers
recommendations.evidence: 982 at-risk customers represent EUR 282,189 in historical net revenue.
recommendations.action: Prioritize high-monetary customers, personalize by last purchased category, and hold out 10% to measure incrementality.

recommendations.evidence: Fashion has the highest average product return rate at 8.7%, putting revenue and service costs at risk.
recommendations.action: Audit the top-returned SKUs, enrich product-detail content, and test fit/compatibility guidance before scaling promotions.
recommendations.expected_impact: Lower refunds and better contribution margin

recommendations.decision: Protect momentum in the South region
recommendations.evidence: Net revenue grew 82.1% in the latest quarter versus the prior quarter, the strongest regional trend.
recommendations.action: Validate whether growth is repeatable by channel and category, then localize inventory and campaigns around the winning mix.
recommendations.expected_impact: Sustained regional growth with inventory support
